headline: Leonardo Tops €60 Billion in Orders on Aerospace and Defence Growth
summary: Italian group Leonardo recorded a 28% increase in orders in the first nine months of 2026, surpassing €60 billion, bolstered by its defence, aerospace, drone divisions, and the acquisition of Iveco Group's Defence division.
why: Growing order backlogs in the defense and aerospace sector provide long-term revenue visibility amid heightened geopolitical security spending.
